title: Last time,|already filled in
note: Open a session and the fields are waiting: the weights and reps you hit on this day last time, one tap from being confirmed.

title: Two sessions,|two histories
note: The same movement in Push 1 and Push 2 progresses at different rates. Every other tracker averages them into one number.

title: Twenty years,|still one tap deep
note: Every session you have ever logged, paged instantly and searchable by movement.

title: Know what|you are training
note: The next session, the cycle you are in, and how far the deload still is — before you put the phone down.

title: Every set,|counted by muscle
note: Six regions, totalled weekly from what you actually logged, normalised to your own biggest number.

title: Build it once,|edit it forever
note: Any number of sessions, in any order. Editing the plan never rewrites what you have already done.
